artifacts.description: feat(sketch): bind dimensions to document parameters

acceptance_criteria: `Sketch::set_dimension_value(id: ConstraintId, value: f64) -> Result<(), SketchError>` changes the value of an existing `Distance`, `Radius` or `Diameter` constraint. It returns an error for an unknown id, for any other constraint kind, and for a value that is not finite or is ≤ 0 (the same rule `add_constraint` uses). No panics.

A new module `swx_sketch::params` with `bind_dimension(sketch: &mut Sketch, doc: &mut Document, c: Constraint) -> Result<(ConstraintId, String), …>`. It adds the constraint, creates a model parameter through `doc.add_model_param(value, "mm")` (Radius/Diameter keep their own value: a diameter dimension of 10 creates a parameter of value 10), records the binding, and returns the constraint id and the parameter name. Non-dimensional constraints return an error and add nothing to either the sketch or the document.
Test: binding three dimensions in a fresh document gives `d0`, `d1`, `d2`, in order, with values equal to the constraint values.

`apply_params(sketch: &mut Sketch, doc: &Document) -> Result<(), …>` copies each bound parameter's current value into its constraint. A binding whose parameter no longer exists returns an error that names it. Test: rectangle 40 × 25 (width and height bound as `d0`, `d1`); `doc.set_param("d0", 60.0)`, `apply_params`, `solve`: the solved width is 60 ± 1e-8 and the height stays 25 ± 1e-8.

Rename: `rename_bound(sketch: &mut Sketch, old: &str, new: &str)` updates the sketch's bindings. Test: `doc.rename_param("d0", "width")` then `rename_bound(.., "d0", "width")`, `doc.set_param("width", 50.0)`, `apply_params`, `solve`: the width is 50 ± 1e-8. `Sketch::bindings()` (or equivalent) lists `(ConstraintId, parameter name)` pairs so callers can inspect them.
Unbound constraints keep working exactly as before; all existing `swx-sketch` and `swx-core` tests pass unchanged.
No `unsafe`; no new third-party dependencies; `swx-sketch` depends only on `swx-core` among workspace crates; one ADR line added.
`cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace` passes.
QA report (FACTORY §6b) posted on the PR.
